summary: Frontend-only testing of GlicoTrack Expo/React Native app via web preview (mobile viewport 390x844). All 13 targeted flows passed: entry form loads at root; glucose color coding is dynamic (120=green rgb(52,199,89), 50=orange rgb(255,159,10), 250=red rgb(255,59,48)); insulin accepts decimals; moment chips highlight (bg becomes brandPrimary rgb(10,102,194)); form validation shows form-error for empty glucose ('Inserisci un valore glicemico valido') and missing moment ('Seleziona il momento della giornata'); save persists via AsyncStorage, shows success toast, resets form; Storico tab shows measurement grouped by day with time, moment label, insulin, note and color-coded value; delete flow opens confirm modal and removes record; empty state renders 'Nessuna misurazione registrata'; Esporta PDF with no data shows info toast 'Nessun dato da esportare'; Esporta PDF with data triggers window.print on web with no page errors or crash. No React Native red screen errors. Only non-blocking console warnings observed from internal RN-Web libs ('shadow* deprecated', 'props.pointerEvents deprecated') — not caused by app code.
critical_code_review_comments: No deprecated Expo packages detected (expo-print, expo-sharing, expo-haptics, expo-image are current; @react-native-community/datetimepicker is used only on iOS/Android as expected).
AsyncStorage persistence via /app/frontend/src/measurements.ts is minimal, correct, and uses React Query invalidation for UI sync.

pdf.ts correctly builds landscape A4 HTML with the 10-column nested-header (Data | Colazione prima/dopo | Pranzo prima/dopo | Merenda prima/dopo | Cena prima/dopo | Notte) and groups measurements by day; cellHtml handles 0/1/2/3 lines per entry as specified.
Minor: console shows 'shadow* deprecated' and 'props.pointerEvents deprecated' warnings; these come from react-native-web internals (not app code) and can be ignored.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral AsyncStorage test data created and fully cleaned up during the test (saved measurements were deleted via the delete flow in the same run).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All critical flows verified on web preview. Date/time pickers are iOS/Android-only (web renders read-only chip) which matches the agent_to_agent_context_note. PDF export on web triggers window.print; to assert no crash, override window.print before clicking export-pdf-button.
